destructive_or_mutating_menu_items.label: Load production system via TFTP then write to NAND.
Load recovery system via TFTP then write to NAND.
Load BL31+U-Boot FIP via TFTP then write to NAND.
Load BL2 preloader via TFTP then write to NAND.
Reset all settings to factory defaults.

important_caveats: This describes upstream SOURCE, not the U-Boot binary currently on the owner's physical router.
A console transcript or exact menu label alone cannot prove physical bootloader authenticity or NAND restore success.
Original observed UBI inventory has no verified independent recovery volume.
Only a trained technician with verified 3.3V UART pinout and the exact appropriate recovery ITB should attempt an interactive RAM boot.
First flash is BLOCK until privately documented physical recovery is demonstrated.
